mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_OwnerOrAdminForMutations allows a non-owner MemberRole actor to appear as the actor on a DescChanged or DescDeleted audit entry. Both OwnershipBasedAccess and FR_008_010_OwnerOrAdminCanMutate check exactly that constraint, so they will find a counterexample once the fact is cleared and the violation is injected.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnerOrAdminViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.aeChangeDesc = DescChanged and ae.aeActor != ae.aeTask.taskOwner and ae.aeActorRole = MemberRole }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_CreatedEntryExistsForEveryTask allows a Task to exist with no corresponding DescCreated AuditEntry. AuditCompleteness and FR_015_OneCreatedEntryPerTask both assert 'one ae | DescCreated for every task', which fails immediately. FR_018_AuditRetention fails because 'some ae | ae.aeTask = t' is violated.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingCreatedEntry { some t: Task | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.aeTask = t and ae.aeChangeDesc = DescCreated }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_DeletedEntryForDeletedTask allows a DeletedTask to exist without a DescDeleted audit entry. FR_016_AuditOutlivesTask asserts 'some ae | DescDeleted for every DeletedTask', which fails. AuditCompleteness also relies on this for the deleted-task branch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingDeletedEntry { some t: DeletedTask | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.aeTask = t and ae.aeChangeDesc = DescDeleted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_PermissionMatrix frees PermMatrix.allowed to take any value. LeastPrivilege checks that MemberRole is not in the PATCH/DELETE cells; injecting exactly that cell violates it. PrivilegeMonotonicity's superset claim and PermissionCompleteness's coverage check also break.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermMatrixViolation { MemberRole -> OpPatchTask in PermMatrix.allowed and MemberRole -> OpDeleteTask in PermMatrix.allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AuditTeamConsistency allows an AuditEntry to carry a aeTeam that differs from aeTask.taskTeam. NoInformationLeakage, FR_011_014_CrossTeamIsolation, and FR_017_AuditReadableByAnyTeamMember all assert aeTeam = aeTask.taskTeam, so a counterexample is immediately found.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamAuditLeak { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.aeTeam != ae.aeTask.taskTeam }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_CreatedEntryActorIsOwner allows a DescCreated audit entry to be attributed to an actor who is not the task's owner. AttributionCorrectness checks exactly this invariant; FR_006_OwnerImmutable's second clause (created entry actor = owner) also fails.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_WrongCreatedActor { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.aeChangeDesc = DescCreated and ae.aeActor != ae.aeTask.taskOwner }
